"""RoboCasa GR1 croissant-to-basket controller (eai-standard/2.1).

Uses only the robot's RGB-D cameras, camera calibration and proprioception.
Depth is unprojected in the camera OpenGL frame; world targets are converted to
robot0_base before issuing ee_pose actions. This is the controller record for
PosttrainPnPNovelFromCuttingboardToBasketSplitA.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import time
import numpy as np
from rcb_client import Robot

DT = 0.05
BASE_T = np.array([2.67072, -2.12925, 0.89836])
# world->base for the fixed +90 degree robot base rotation
def world_to_base(p):
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float)
    return np.array([p[1] + 2.12925, -(p[0] - 2.67072), p[2] - 0.89836])

def unproject(u, v, depth, cam):
    """One RGB-D pixel to world; depth is axial metres, cam2world is OpenGL."""
    K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], float)
    T = np.asarray(cam["cam2world_gl"], float)
    z = float(depth)
    q = np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0], -(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1], -z, 1.0])
    return (T @ q)[:3]

def orange_component(rgb, depth):
    """Estimate the croissant center from its orange/brown pixels and depth."""
    a = np.asarray(rgb).astype(np.int16)
    r,g,b = a[...,0], a[...,1], a[...,2]
    mask = (r > 95) & (g > 30) & (g < 175) & (b < 105) & (r-g > 22) & (g-b > 4)
    # Connected components with an 8-neighbour flood fill, keeping plausible food-sized blobs.
    h,w = mask.shape
    seen = np.zeros_like(mask, bool)
    best = None
    for y,x in zip(*np.where(mask & ~seen)):
        if seen[y,x]: continue
        stack=[(int(y),int(x))]; seen[y,x]=True; pts=[]
        while stack:
            yy,xx=stack.pop(); pts.append((yy,xx))
            for dy in (-1,0,1):
                for dx in (-1,0,1):
                    ny,nx=yy+dy,xx+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and mask[ny,nx] and not seen[ny,nx]:
                        seen[ny,nx]=True; stack.append((ny,nx))
        if 18 <= len(pts) <= 1800:
            ys=np.fromiter((p[0] for p in pts), int); xs=np.fromiter((p[1] for p in pts), int)
            # Exclude tiny highlights and favor compact croissant-like components.
            score=len(pts) - 2*max(0, abs((xs.max()-xs.min())-(ys.max()-ys.min()))-18)
            if best is None or score > best[0]: best=(score,ys,xs)
    if best is None: raise RuntimeError("croissant not visible in selected RGB-D camera")
    _,ys,xs=best
    d=np.asarray(depth).squeeze()
    valid=d[ys,xs] > 0
    ys,xs=ys[valid],xs[valid]
    # Median over the central part avoids the board and hand silhouette.
    cy,cx=np.median(ys),np.median(xs)
    rad=(xs-cx)**2+(ys-cy)**2
    keep=rad <= np.percentile(rad,65)
    pts=[unproject(x,y,d[y,x], current_cam) for y,x in zip(ys[keep],xs[keep])]
    return np.median(np.asarray(pts),axis=0)

class Controller:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r=Robot(); self.spec=self.r.spec(); self.dt=float(self.spec["control_dt"])
        self.cams=["egoview","robot0_agentview_right"]

    def observe(self):
        return self.r.get_obs(cameras=self.cams,include_depth=True,video="none")

    def act_pose(self, right_world, left_world, right_rot, left_rot,
                 right_fingers, left_fingers, seconds=1.0):
        o=self.observe(); n=np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"],float)
        # ee_pose row: right xyz/rvec, left xyz/rvec, six hand controls each.
        cur=np.r_[n[84:96],n[96:108]]
        goal=np.r_[world_to_base(right_world),right_rot,world_to_base(left_world),left_rot,
                   right_fingers,left_fingers]
        count=max(1,int(round(seconds/self.dt)))
        rows=np.stack([cur+(goal-cur)*(i+1)/count for i in range(count)])
        return self.r.submit("ee_pose",rows,interpolate="hold",cameras=self.cams,video="none")

    def run(self):
        o=self.observe()
        # Choose the camera frame that shows the cutting board and fit the food blob.
        global current_cam
        current_cam=o.meta["cameras"]["egoview"]
        obj=orange_component(o.last["egoview"],o.depth["egoview"])
        # Basket opening center, read from the same calibrated tabletop view.
        basket=np.array([2.63,-1.50,0.98])
        right_rot=np.array([np.pi,0.,0.])  # palm down for a top approach
        left_rot=np.array([0.,0.,0.])
        # Hover, descend, close, lift, transfer over the basket, release and retreat.
        n=np.asarray(o.meta["proprio"]["now"],float)
        left=n[78:81].copy(); right=n[81:84].copy()
        fingers=np.zeros(6); closed=np.array([1.3,1.3,1.3,1.3,1.3,0.])
        self.act_pose(obj+np.array([0,0,.18]),left,right_rot,left_rot,fingers,fingers,1.5)
        self.act_pose(obj+np.array([0,0,.045]),left,right_rot,left_rot,fingers,fingers,1.0)
        self.act_pose(obj+np.array([0,0,.045]),left,right_rot,left_rot,closed,fingers,.6)
        self.act_pose(obj+np.array([0,0,.20]),left,right_rot,left_rot,closed,fingers,1.0)
        self.act_pose(basket+np.array([0,0,.22]),left,right_rot,left_rot,closed,fingers,2.0)
        self.act_pose(basket+np.array([0,0,.12]),left,right_rot,left_rot,fingers,fingers,1.0)
        # Leave both hands far from the basket and object for the graded state.
        safe_r=np.array([2.05,-2.20,1.35]); safe_l=np.array([2.05,-2.00,1.35])
        self.act_pose(safe_r,safe_l,right_rot,left_rot,fingers,fingers,2.0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    Controller().run()
